stats.publicationScope: Targeted business publishers and official company domains; headline discovery only

limitations: Public discovery display is capped at 10 headline rows per company/month, preferring targeted publishers then recency; the full validated research collection is retained separately.
This is public headline discovery, not full-article review or comprehensive licensed-media coverage.
Google News RSS may cap results and omit older stories; bounded monthly refinements reduce but cannot remove this gap.
Publication dates/source dates remain publication metadata, not the date of a research check.
Paywalls and unavailable feeds are recorded; no access restrictions are bypassed.
Missing headlines do not establish that a company has no news, funding, or operational changes.
Similar company names require identity and sector context. All leads require human/source review before an investment decision.
DealStreetAsia public RSS usage is limited to attributed headlines/backlinks; no licensed wire article text is republished.
